## Exercise 5 — Vectorization
 
```{r}

# Comparing loop vs vectorized
x <- 1:1e6

# Loop
loop_square <- function(x){
  out <- numeric(length(x))
  for(i in seq_along(x)){
    out[i] <- x[i]^2
  }
  out
}

system.time(loop_square(x))

# Vectorized
system.time(vect <- x^2)

# Recycling rule
1:10 + 1:3

```
 
## Exercise 6 — Functional programming
 
```{r}
# Compute column means using lapply
df <- data.frame(a=1:5, b=6:10, c=11:15)
lapply(df, mean)

# Reduce: cumulative sum of list elements
Reduce(`+`, list(1:3, 4:6, 7:9))

# Filter: keep only even numbers
Filter(function(z) z %% 2 == 0, 1:20)

```
 
## Exercise 7 — Writing functions
 
```{r}
row_standardize <- function(mat){
  med <- apply(mat, 1, median)
  md  <- apply(mat, 1, mad)
  sweep(sweep(mat, 1, med, "-"), 1, md, "/")
}

# Test
set.seed(1)
mat <- matrix(rnorm(25), nrow = 5)
row_standardize(mat)

```
 
## Exercise 8 — Replacement function
 
```{r}
`rowrep<-` <- function(x, i, value){
  x[i, ] <- value
  x
}

# Example
m <- matrix(1:9, nrow = 3)
rowrep(m, 2) <- c(9,9,9)
m

```

## Exercise 9 — Exception handling

```{r}
safe_div <- function(x, y){
  tryCatch({
    x / y
  }, warning = function(w){
    message("Warning: ", w$message)
    NA
  }, error = function(e){
    message("Error: ", e$message)
    NA
  })
}

safe_div(10, 0)  # triggers error
safe_div(10, 2)

```

## Assignment 2

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Simulate matrix
set.seed(1)
mat <- matrix(rnorm(100*10), nrow=100)

# Standardize rows
mat_std <- row_standardize(mat)

# Variance per gene
gene_var <- apply(mat_std, 1, var)

# Top 10
order(gene_var, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]

```

## Home assignment

```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(stringr)

# Simulate sequences
seqs <- c("ATGATCGAATG", "CGTATGATGAA", "TTTATGCCC")

# Count ATG
motif_counts <- sapply(seqs, function(s) str_count(s, "ATG"))

df <- data.frame(
  id = paste0("seq", 1:length(seqs)),
  seq = seqs,
  atg_count = motif_counts
)

df

```
